name: Custom Agent Commands
description: Any program that takes a message and prints an answer (aider, llm, a script of yours) as an agent in the AI Chat. Add one with “Chat: Add a Custom Agent Command…”.
author: AICode

commands.description: One agent per entry: { "id", "name", "program", "args": ["--message", "{prompt}"] }. {prompt} is the message, {model} the model typed in the chat.
